title: LaunchReel — from a terminal recording to an editable timeline

card.title: LaunchReel
card.subtitle: Your terminal recording, as an editable timeline

shots.label: M3 reads the cast and designs the timeline
Closing card with the install command

narration.text: You shipped something. Now you need a video about it.
Record your terminal the way you already do — with vhs or asciinema.
LaunchReel reads the recording, works out what actually happened, and designs a timeline around it.
You get an mp4. You also get the timeline itself, which opens in Resolve, Premiere, or Final Cut.
Every clip carries the prompt and model that made it, so a re-edit knows where it came from.

music.caption: Restrained electronic underscore for a developer tool launch. Warm analog pads, muted plucks, no drums until the midpoint, then a soft four-on-the-floor. Confident, not triumphant.
